description: Two previously unused ACL Anthology papers prepared for parser-first, app-context-gated evaluation.
reclassification_reason: Parser, retrieval, and exact app-context gates all passed 12/12, but the first application-answer run produced only 7 correct and 5 partial cases. The deterministic structured-table answer path omitted requested rows or columns in five multi-value questions, so this set is no longer unseen.
freeze_policy: The candidate must pass PDF parser evidence preflight before being marked frozen-unseen. After freezing, any implementation, prompt, case, or retrieval configuration change motivated by H14 reclassifies it as development-regression.
